look_at_obj_in_light.goal:
(:goal
             (and
                 (exists (?ot - object
                          ?r - receptacle
                          ?a - agent
                          ?l - location)
                     (and
                         (objectType ?ot DeskLampType)
                         (toggleable ?ot)
                         (isToggled ?ot)
                         (receptacleAtLocation ?r ?l)
                         (atLocation ?a ?l)
                         (inReceptacle ?ot ?r)
                     )
                 )
                 (exists (?o - object
                          ?a - agent)
                     (and
                         (objectType ?o BowlType)
                         (holds ?a ?o)
                     )
                 )
             )
        )
look_at_obj_in_light.task_text: Your task is to: examine the bowl with the desklamp.
